'''Kaelus Fane''' was a hero of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who owned a famous [[Kaellus Fane's armor|set of armor]] valued by collectors. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Republic [[General/Legends|general]] [[Oma'gorek]] sought to acquire the complete armor, and his hired agents located the final piece&mdash;the gauntlets&mdash;in an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] scrap yard before they were incinerated.
